description: An is-a relationship from a child Food concept to its parent in the FoodOn ontology. Only links between named, active FOODON classes are represented. Links to classes in other ontologies and restriction-based relationships are absent, so a Food concept whose only named parents are external can appear as a root in this hierarchy.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources supporting the relationship; FoodOn contributes the value "foodon".

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp when the relationship was created or its source support changed.

source_contributions.scope: Named is-a links between non-obsolete FOODON classes. FoodOn covers food products, food-source organisms and their parts, food processes, packaging and contact materials, and food data specifications, with no category filter.
source_contributions.description: FoodOn provides a hierarchy of Food concepts through named superclass assertions. Both the child and parent must be active FOODON classes; external, deprecated and undeclared parents are excluded.
